title: What a virtual machine is and what it saves you

videos.script: A virtual machine is a computer made of software. It runs inside a real one, which we call the host. {{host}} From inside, it looks like any other computer. It has processors, memory, a disk and a network card. It boots, you log in, you install things. {{inside}} From outside, on the host, it is a program that is running, and a file on the disk. {{outside}} That changes what you can afford to do with it. You can make one in a minute. You can break it on purpose and throw it away. You can keep ten on one laptop, each a different system. {{uses}} In this lesson you will make one, look at it from both sides, switch it off and on, destroy its system from inside, and then delete it. The host will not notice. {{lab}} At the end we look at what it costs, because memory, disk and processor time all come from the host. {{cost}}
